job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and implement Agentic AI solutions using autonomous and multi-agent frameworks.
Develop intelligent workflows using LLMs and AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.



Required:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in AWS cloud technologies.
2+ years of hands-on experience with Agentic AI systems.
Strong programming experience in Python, SQL, and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including:
EC2
Lambda
S3
CloudFormation
Step Functions
DynamoDB
RDS
Knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks:
LangChain
LangGraph
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
